newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish SILF index rises to 53.1 in November.
newsitem.headline: Swedish SILF index rises to 53.1 in November.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Sparbanken's SILF purchasing managers' index rose to 53.1 in November from 52.3 in October and 48.5 in November 1995.
"This confirms the successive improvement of the business cycle since the summer... order stocks seem to have decreased somewhat in November," SILF/Sparbanken said in a statement.

"The index for order intake and production, which are weighted heaviest in the index, increased in November. The improvement in the index was for order intake following a somewhat weaker trend in October," it said.
It said order intake improved for both domestic and export markets. The improvement in the economy did not create any new employment, it said.
Sparbanken is known internationally as Swedbank.
